# HonanSafe — Hong'an Fire Fighting Equipment Co., Ltd.

> Hong'an Fire Fighting Equipment Co., Ltd. is a direct factory manufacturer and exporter of fire protection equipment,
> founded in 2003 in Nan'an, Fujian, China. We operate three production bases covering 35,000+ m² with 500+ product
> specifications across nine product series and 100+ national patents. We serve engineering contractors and distributors
> in Southeast Asia, the Middle East and South America with OEM/ODM customisation and complete project package supply.

## Company

- Legal name: Hong'an Fire Fighting Equipment Co., Ltd. (鸿安消防设备有限公司)
- Brand / domain: HonanSafe — https://honansafe.com/
- Founded: 2003
- Production: 3 production bases, 35,000+ m² production area
- Range: 500+ specifications, 9 product series, 100+ national patents
- Track record: 500+ projects delivered across 30+ provinces in China

## Certifications held by the factory

- ISO 9001 quality management system (No. 04324Q30857R0S, valid to 14 Apr 2027)
- ISO 14001 environmental management system (No. 04324E30685R0S)
- ISO 45001 occupational health and safety (No. 04324S40639R0S)
- HSE health, safety and environment management system (No. 126225MS1943R0S, valid to 24 Mar 2028)
- IPMS intellectual property management system (No. 069241PMSZ0308R0)
- Green Factory rating AAAAA (No. 126224MS7724R0S, valid to 20 Nov 2027)
- After-sales service certification, five-star (GB/T 27922-2011)
- National High-Tech Enterprise (No. GR202435001722)
- China Fire Protection Association member (No. 1447)
- Enterprise credit grade AAA; EPEC legal-entity credit grade A; 2024 fire equipment Top-10 brand

Note: the ISO management-system scope covers fire water supply, sprinkler, fire hose, foam and gas extinguishing
equipment; extinguisher products are covered by the HSE, IPMS and green-factory certificates.

## Product lines

- [Fire Extinguishers & Cabinets](https://honansafe.com/products/fire-extinguishers.html) — ABC dry powder (1–12 kg), water-based, CO2, wall cabinets
- [Hose, Nozzles & Couplings](https://honansafe.com/products/hose-nozzles.html) — 12 fire hose types (TPU, synthetic rubber, forest, marine, DURALINE, reflective, floating, drainage DN150–300 and more) plus STORZ / GOST / British / MACHINO / CE couplings
- [Hydrant Systems](https://honansafe.com/products/hydrant-systems.html) — indoor/outdoor hydrants DN50–DN150, boxes, valves, pump connections
- [Sprinkler & Water Systems](https://honansafe.com/products/sprinkler-systems.html) — sprinkler heads, wet alarm valves, flow indicators
- [Fire Alarm Systems](https://honansafe.com/products/fire-alarm.html) — smoke/heat detectors, call points, sounders, panels
- [Gas Suppression & PPE](https://honansafe.com/products/other.html) — clean-agent suppression, fire blankets, firefighter PPE
